title: BGP TCP session never opens — TCP-MD5 key mismatch
symptom: BGP neighbor state cycles Active/Idle; no OPEN reaches R3; TCP socket repeatedly resets.

inject.note: R3 carries a different MD5 key; the TCP-MD5 hash fails, sockets are silently dropped.

ground_truth.root_cause: TCP-MD5 password mismatch on R2<->R3 — TCP segments fail authentication, BGP never establishes
ground_truth.fix: router bgp 65001 / no neighbor 192.0.2.2 password ... / neighbor 192.0.2.2 password <agreed-key>
ground_truth.verify: TCP session opens; BGP reaches Established
